label: a ship of each Rebel class
eval: (() => { const by = {}; for (const p of __map.map.plates.values()) if (p.ship.side === 'rebels' && !by[p.ship.cls]) by[p.ship.cls] = p.key; window.__rebels = by; return JSON.stringify(by); })()

(() => { const m = __map.map; const p = m.plates.get(window.__rebels.small); const b = new m.THREE.Box3().setFromObject(p.shipGroup); const c = b.getCenter(new m.THREE.Vector3()); m.flyTo(new m.THREE.Vector3(c.x - 50, c.y + 30, b.max.z + 45), c); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const m = __map.map; const p = m.plates.get(window.__rebels.medium); const b = new m.THREE.Box3().setFromObject(p.shipGroup); const c = b.getCenter(new m.THREE.Vector3()); m.flyTo(new m.THREE.Vector3(c.x + 70, c.y + 25, c.z + 60), c); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const m = __map.map; const p = m.plates.get(window.__rebels.large); const b = new m.THREE.Box3().setFromObject(p.shipGroup); const c = b.getCenter(new m.THREE.Vector3()); m.flyTo(new m.THREE.Vector3(c.x - 90, c.y + 40, b.max.z + 70), c); return 'ok'; })()

label: frames per second, headless (software WebGL)
eval: new Promise((r) => { let n = 0; const t0 = performance.now(); const f = () => { n++; if (performance.now() - t0 < 2000) requestAnimationFrame(f); else r((n / 2).toFixed(1)); }; requestAnimationFrame(f); })

(() => { const m = __map.map; const T = m.THREE; const f = m.battle.fighters.find((x) => x.kind === 'xwing') ?? m.battle.fighters[0]; window.__f = f; const p = f.obj.position; m.flyTo(new T.Vector3(p.x + 14, p.y + 6, p.z + 14), p.clone()); return f.kind; })()
label: fly up to a fighter

eval: (() => { const m = __map.map; const T = m.THREE; const f = window.__f; const p = f.obj.position; m.flight = null; m.camera.position.set(p.x + 9, p.y + 4, p.z + 9); const d = p.clone().sub(m.camera.position).normalize(); m.yaw = Math.atan2(-d.x, -d.z); m.pitch = Math.asin(d.y); m.battle.enabled = false; return 'held'; })()

(() => { const m = __map.map; const t = m.battle.fighters.find((x) => x.kind === 'tie'); const p = t.obj.position; m.camera.position.set(p.x + 8, p.y + 3, p.z + 8); const d = p.clone().sub(m.camera.position).normalize(); m.yaw = Math.atan2(-d.x, -d.z); m.pitch = Math.asin(d.y); return 'tie'; })()

(() => { const m = __map.map; const T = m.THREE; m.battle.enabled = true; const at = m.camera.position.clone().add(new T.Vector3(0, 0, -40)); m.yaw = 0; m.pitch = 0; m.battle.explode(at, 18, { ring: true, debris: 16 }); return 'boom'; })()
